# FamParty

> A party game show for one big screen and everyone's phones. A host runs the show from their phone, a TV (or shared screen) only displays, and 3–12 players join with a QR code or 4-letter room code. No accounts, no app installs, no payments.

FamParty is run by Hilly Shore Inc. (California, United States). Games: Emoji Decoder (guess the phrase from emojis), Spotlight (two truths and a lie with a story beat), Spectrum (place yourself between opposites and predict the crowd), Finish It (anonymous sentence completions, voted), and the memory game (currently unavailable) (guess who wrote a saved true statement). An optional family album link keeps a roster, saved true statements and scores in Redis; album keys expire automatically 60 days after last activity.

## Notes for agents

- Live rooms expire after 2 hours. Family albums expire 60 days after last activity.
- The running app makes no AI model calls. Content packs are currently hand-written starters awaiting the offline Muse generation run and human review.
- App surfaces (/host, /join, /tv) and family album pages (/f/...) are not for indexing.
